description: Central Province - Amendment to the Gazette Ex. No. 2112/47 of 01.03.2019 Central Province
reasoning: This gazette exclusively details structural and administrative changes to ministerial portfolios within the Central Province. It amends the subjects and responsibilities assigned to specific ministries (e.g., moving "Tourism" from one ministry to another, adding "Environmental Affairs" to another). While the Governor's name is mentioned as the issuing authority, the content's focus is solely on the reassignment of functions and duties between government departments, with no specific personnel appointments or detailed responsibilities assigned to named individuals. This fits the definition of an Organisational Gazette (Type 1).
